card.title: Say the Scary Part
card.instruction: Get someone else to name the frightening possibility or vulnerable feeling before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we open the landlord's letter, tell me the worst thing it could mean for our shop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know the number. I need you to say the thing I'm counting towards.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And what would that make me, after Dad trusted me with it? Say that bit first too.

mechanism: A makes B name the feared shop loss and then the vulnerable self-judgment before A says either.
confusable: Unlike asking for risk analysis, A must seek the other person's first articulation of the frightening meaning.
comparison: D104-a moves from losing the shop to failing Dad; D104-b moves from failed qualification to fear of losing the partner.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
